ITEM 4.  CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES
Based on their evaluation as of August 28, 2026, our Chief Executive Officer and Interim Chief Financial Officer have concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) were effective at the reasonable assurance level to ensure that the information required to be disclosed by us in this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q was (i) recorded, processed, summarized and reported within the time periods specified in the SEC s rules and regulations and (ii) accumulated and communicated to our management, including our Chief Executive Officer and Interim Chief Financial Officer, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure.
There were no changes in our internal control over financial reporting during the quarter ended August 28, 2026 that have materially affected, or are reasonably likely to materially affect, our internal control over financial reporting.
Our management, including our Chief Executive Officer and Interim Chief Financial Officer, does not expect that our disclosure controls and procedures or our internal control over financial reporting will prevent all errors and all fraud. A control system, no matter how well conceived and operated, can provide only reasonable, not absolute, assurance that the objectives of the control system are met. Further, the design of a control system must reflect the fact that there are resource constraints, and the benefits of controls must be considered relative to their costs. Because of the inherent limitations in all control systems, no evaluation of controls can provide absolute assurance that all control issues and instances of fraud, if any, within Adobe have been detected.

ITEM 4. 開示統制および手続

2026年8月28日時点の評価に基づき、当社の最高経営責任者および暫定最高財務責任者は、当社の開示統制および手続（1934年証券取引法に基づく規則13a-15(e)および15d-15(e)で定義されるもの）が、Form 10-Q四半期報告書において開示が求められる情報を(i) SEC規則および規制で定められた期間内に記録、処理、要約および報告し、(ii) 適時な開示判断を可能にするため、当社の経営陣（最高経営責任者および暫定最高財務責任者を含む）に集積・伝達することを、合理的な保証レベルで確保する上で有効であると判断した。

2026年8月28日を末日とする四半期において、当社の財務報告に係る内部統制に重大な変更はなく、また重大な影響を及ぼす、または及ぼす可能性の高い変更も生じていない。

経営陣（最高経営責任者および暫定最高財務責任者を含む）は、開示統制および手続または財務報告に係る内部統制がすべての誤謬および不正を防止できるとは想定していない。統制システムは、いかに適切に設計・運用されても、統制目的の達成について合理的な保証しか提供できず、絶対的な保証は提供できない。また、統制システムの設計は資源制約を考慮し、統制の便益とコストを比較衡量しなければならない。すべての統制システムに内在する限界により、Adobeにおけるすべての統制上の問題および不正の有無について、評価により絶対的な保証を得ることはできない。
